title: Wendell and the Kitchen
author: Lior Underhill
blurb: Elodie Villalobos, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must let someone stay after the last train leaves, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
